description: Build crisp-game-lib mini-games, set up licensed game typography, and verify browser runtime health and mechanic conformance.

codex.shortDescription: Build crisp-game-lib games and verify browser mechanics.
defaultPrompts: Build a compact browser game using crisp-game-lib.
Smoke-test this browser game for runtime errors.
Verify this game mechanic against its written spec.

requirements: Browser probes need Node.js 18+, Playwright, and Chromium available in the target project.
The crisp-game-lib workflow applies only to projects using crisp-game-lib.
Fonts must be obtained and licensed for redistribution; font binaries are not bundled.
